title: Prism component spec
description: Contract for one Prism component. Applied to spec/components/*.yaml. See spec/SCHEMA.md for intent; tools/spec/validate.ts checks what JSON Schema cannot (token paths, the binding-matrix axes, component tokens, prose and examples).

density.description: The density contexts the component responds to; `watch` is the watchOS default (ADR-0029 §3.2).

parent.description: the part that contains this one, listed earlier in anatomy; absent, a part listed after root sits directly in root (spec/SCHEMA.md, Anatomy)

slot.description: true when the part accepts arbitrary child content

tokens.description: part -> property -> binding, plus one block per state. A binding is a token path or a matrix keyed by ONE axis: the values of one enum prop, the material the enclosing Surface publishes, or the backdrop kind it publishes with it, beside the reserved key `default`. A value with no cell and no `default` is simply not set (the ghost button has no rest fill). spec/SCHEMA.md states the grammar; tools/spec/validate.ts checks the axes.

motion.description: What the component animates, and what it does under Reduce Motion (ADR-0023 rule 9). Every binding but `reduceMotion` is a motion role or the component's own comp.<component>.motion.* token.

reduceTransparency.description: Required (ADR-0011, ADR-0022 rule 9): what the component looks like when glass resolves to raised.

reduceMotion.description: Required (ADR-0022 rule 9, ADR-0023 rule 9): the substitute in words, naming the token it reaches; it must agree with `motion.reduceMotion`.

surface.description: What the example is rendered on when the props do not say it themselves. `glass` and `glassLight` name the enclosing material, and `backdrop` then says what that material sits on.

backdrop.description: What the enclosing surface sits on, when `surface` names a glass material rather than the backdrop itself (ADR-0029 §1.4: the scheme's glass keys its tones by this).

schemes.description: Schemes the example renders in; both unless the look belongs to one (a `tinted` Card is light only, ADR-0030 §3.3).

grid.description: A 2x2 of vivid tiles, row-major: the gradient slots of top-leading, top-trailing, bottom-leading and bottom-trailing. One slot pair alternates on the diagonals, so the grid is one temperature (ADR-0029 §2.5).

tokenPath.description: A sys.* token written without the sys prefix, in one of the spec-bindable categories, or a comp.<component>.* token of this spec's own component (ADR-0024 §5.3). The alternation above is the single copy of the bindable set; tools/spec/validate.ts reads it back and classifies every sys category against it.

motionBinding.description: ADR-0023 rule 9: the motion block binds only motion.spring.*, motion.duration.*, motion.easing.* or comp.<component>.motion.*.

oneOf.description: A matrix keyed by one axis: the values of one enum prop, a published material, a published backdrop, or `default`.
